name: share_file
description: Share a local file through the WebUI so anyone who can open the WebUI (including LAN visitors) can download it. Default mode serves the original file directly with zero copying; the link stops working if the file is moved, modified, or deleted. Pass snapshot=true to copy the file into managed storage for a persistent share. Videos, audio, and images can be previewed inline in the WebUI shared-files panel. Also supports listing existing shares and removing one.

path.description: Absolute path (or ~/ relative to home) of the local file to share. Required for the share action.

title.description: Optional display title shown in the WebUI shared-files list.

snapshot.description: Copy the file into managed storage so the link keeps working even if the original file changes. Default false: serve the original file directly.

action.description: Defaults to share. list returns all current shares; unshare removes one by share_id.

share_id.description: The share to remove. Required for the unshare action.
